world_rationale: Independently inspected all169 added recipe rows and110 new definitions. Inherited116 exact prior recipe judgments and111 byte-identical concept records. The expanded book doubles practical vocabulary and craftable results while keeping eight familiar starters. New foundations support coherent chains for emulsions, dough, sauces, fillings, vegetables and complete dishes. Removed generic grill-to-Kurtos, introduced cooked cabbage before Cluj cabbage, made oven/pan toast consistent and added cutting toast into croutons, and required pistachio-kataif filling before Dubai chocolate. Old rules, goals and supply tiers remain exact. Pantry gifts stay explicitly separate from crafts. All accepted recipes are plausible canonical game associations with omitted preparation disclosed, never claims of unique two-ingredient culinary causation. No alcohol-dependent/adult framing or global KG mutation. No human playtest claimed.
